notes.title: VR-Kanojo Ver 1.0.8 Update Released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078030/942dfe1012abb4e1fc9fb5fe10eb4f785cc4602b.jpg[/img]
Thank you for playing [b]VR-Kanojo[/b].
We have released the Ver 1.0.8 update today.

The changes in this update are as follows:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where thumbnails were not displayed correctly when saving My Coordinate.
[/list]
※ Please note: Thumbnails for coordinates saved in the past will not be corrected, but new saves from now on will display correctly.

We will continue to make improvements so you can enjoy a more comfortable experience.
Thank you for your continued support of *VR-Kanojo*.

notes.title: Ver 1.0.5 Update Released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078030/1a7e35291ac56d442c45a6f72eef4c3f54701947.jpg[/img]
Thank you for playing *VR-Kanojo*.  
The Ver 1.0.5 update has been released! Here are the main changes:

[list]
[*] Adjusted parts of the ending  
[*] Added a new achievement related to the ending update  
[*] You can now grab objects directly without using the Ray  
[*] Added an option to hide the Ray  
[*] You can now switch between “Outfit” and “Extra” without going back to the title screen  
[/list]

We will continue working to improve the game so you can enjoy it even more!

notes.title: 【UPDATE】Ver. 1.0.1 Patch Notes Released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078030/a05b70c56fce0de0bf73673f434d62861e862168.jpg[/img]
[p]Thank you for playing “VR Kanojo.” Today we released update Ver. 1.0.1. The key fixes are as follows:[/p]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]■ Patch Notes (Ver. 1.0.1)[/h2]
[list]
[*]Even when “Gravity Off” is selected in Settings, the RC car is now always affected by gravity
[*]Fixed an issue where the male genital position could shift during the hand-job scene
[*]Fixed an issue where Sakura’s lip gloss could disappear under certain skin-shader settings
[*]Fixed a progression-blocking bug that occurred if DLC data was deleted while the DLC outfit was equipped
[*]Other minor bug fixes
[/list]

[p]We always appreciate your feedback. Thank you for your continued support of “VR Kanojo”![/p]

notes.title: Thank You! VR-Kanojo Crowdfunding Reaches 1,166% of the Goal!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078030/0ba011ff5d50492555a9e6d2cffe21a5ba358512.png[/img]
Thanks to your generous support, the VR-Kanojo crowdfunding campaign on CAMPFIRE was a huge success! With the incredible support of 835 backers, we raised [b]¥23,326,000[/b], reaching [b]1,166%[/b] of our initial goal. This also marks the highest amount of support ever for a VR game on CAMPFIRE! We are deeply grateful to all of you.

[h2]Crowdfunding Results Summary:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Total Amount Raised[/b]: ¥23,326,000 (1,166% of the initial goal)
[*] [b]Backer Count[/b]: 835 supporters
[*] [b]Campaign Period[/b]: September 2, 2024 – October 19, 2024
[*] [b]Platform[/b]: [url=https://camp-fire.jp/projects/756138/view]CAMPFIRE[/url]
[/list]

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078030/c240e3aeab22e4db709e5bbf0134b564f05892d3.png[/img]
Thanks to your amazing support, we will be adding a variety of new content, including a nurse outfit, bunny suit, "killer sweater," boyfriend’s shirt, maid outfit, and naked apron. We’re excited to further expand the world of VR-Kanojo and offer even more to our players.

[h2]A Message of Gratitude[/h2]

[h3]From CEO Miumyu:[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078030/1bdb91a9d1239de8d4738f11783a063c83f72b9b.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078030/e94151f95ffaae6c311c1a658d9f2e6cc24673e4.jpg[/img][/url]
Thank you all so much!! This crowdfunding campaign was a success thanks to your incredible support! We’re filled with gratitude. We’ll continue to work hard to make VR-Kanojo even more amazing, so please continue supporting us!

[h3]From Producer Yunayuna:[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078030/ed6e6e03fd2276bef719c9d18cf739c8c98441ca.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078030/442da6800e2e742d133345a5b8f6b2db2f1acc66.jpg[/img][/url]
Thank you so much for supporting the VR-Kanojo project! With your incredible backing, we were able to exceed our goal by 1,166%! We are full of gratitude, and our team will continue to work hard to deliver an experience that exceeds your expectations!

[h2]Upcoming Schedule:[/h2]

VR-Kanojo is currently in development, targeting a release in February 2025. We will implement all the stretch goals unlocked during the crowdfunding campaign and strive to deliver an experience that exceeds your expectations. We’ll keep you updated with the latest progress and news, so stay tuned!

For the latest updates, follow our official website and X (Twitter):

Official Website: [url=https://vr-kanojo.com/]https://vr-kanojo.com/[/url]
X (Twitter): [url=https://x.com/ILLUMINAstaff]https://x.com/ILLUMINAstaff[/url]

Once again, thank you all for your incredible support. We appreciate your continued backing for the development of VR-Kanojo!

notes.title: Astonishing Speed Achieves Goal! 'VR-Kanojo' Crowdfunding Exceeds 2 Million Yen
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078030/e091b2aa86a7b61ed9ee169d7374a11da1e119f0.png[/img]

The [url=https://camp-fire.jp/projects/756138/view]crowdfunding campaign[/url] for the next-generation VR game "VR-Kanojo," which started at 19:00 on September 2nd, exceeded its goal of 2 million yen in an astonishingly short time of just 1 hour and 40 minutes after launch!

"VR-Kanojo" is a brand-new VR entertainment experience developed with the aim of challenging the limits of VR technology and delivering unprecedented immersion and emotion. By utilizing the latest modeling techniques and shader development, it creates a realistic experience that feels as if you are spending time with a real girlfriend.

This incredibly fast achievement is all thanks to the support of everyone who contributed, and the entire team is filled with gratitude. Therefore, we have set new next goals to aim for further content additions! With each new goal reached, a new outfit for the heroine "Sakura Yuuhi" in "VR-Kanojo" will be unlocked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078030/5a506615219d16acabd497584e26505c044d23a4.png[/img]

[b]Achieving 5 million yen (250%):[/b] Nurse Outfit unlocked!
[b]Achieving 6 million yen (300%):[/b] Bunny Suit unlocked!
[b]Achieving 8 million yen (400%):[/b] The "Virgin-Killer Sweater" will be added!

Each outfit is designed to provide players with even more excitement and satisfaction. The funds raised will be used for further technical development and content creation to deliver a more advanced VR experience to everyone.

The crowdfunding campaign continues, and we are still seeking your support. Please check out the project page for the latest progress and details!

Your enthusiastic support will help pave the way for the future of next-generation VR entertainment. We look forward to your continued support of "VR-Kanojo"!

[h2]Crowdfunding Overview[/h2]
[b]Period:[/b] September 2, 2024 – October 19, 2024

[b]Platform:[/b] CAMPFIRE
